what: QED on-chain vault journey through the backend API: each household's vault owned by its passkeys
howToReproduce: node scripts/vault-journey.ts --isolated <report.json> (starts its own vault service, chain, engine and API)

steps.name: the vault service answers through QED's API
steps.expected: available, multi-tenant, and this household has a vault
steps.observed: available true; mode multi-tenant; set up true; Local Anvil chain 31337 · valueless test tokens · service keys derived from this installation's secret; owners are passkey accounts

steps.name: setting up the vault: an owner account whose one signer is this passkey
steps.expected: awaiting acceptance; a passkey account; one signer, this passkey; signatures from this origin
steps.observed: status awaiting-acceptance; owner passkey-account 0x773D1d99…; signers 1 of 1; threshold 1; origin http://localhost:5195

steps.name: accepting the vault: the passkey signs the owner account's digest of the two acceptOwnership calls
steps.expected: executed with one passkey signature; the opening grant of 1,00,000.00 tINR arrives only now
steps.observed: done: executed; 1 digest signed; treasury 100000.00 tINR

steps.name: signing a mandate
steps.expected: executed; an active mandate of 250 a payment, 600 a day, 2,000 in all, signed by the passkey through the owner account (ERC-1271)
steps.observed: done: executed; version 1, 250.00 / 600.00 / 2000.00 tINR; 1 digest signed

steps.name: the approval that signed it is on the mandate
steps.expected: the mandate carries this approval's id
steps.observed: mandate approval apr_1m817s1g88tdjv; used apr_1m817s1g88tdjv

steps.name: a payment to the one approved outside payee
steps.expected: executed; 3 tINR leaves the treasury
steps.observed: done: executed; treasury 100000.00 to 99997.00; transaction 0x892a081bbc… in block 59

steps.name: a payment to a name that is not in the owner's book
steps.expected: refused before any terms exist
steps.observed: 422 unknown_payee

steps.name: a payment promised for a later day, and money the owner sets aside for a creditor
steps.expected: both executed; two open promises of 2 and 4 tINR; 6 tINR no longer free; nothing has left
steps.observed: done: executed; done: executed; open 2.00 due 1797930046, 4.00 due 1797930046; ring-fenced 6.00; balance 99997.00

steps.name: what a payment may be, read without preparing anything
steps.expected: 5 of the co-signer's 10 tINR left; 5 is the most payable; one unit more is refused; reading uses none of the service's budget
steps.observed: left 5.00 of 10.00; most 5.00; 5.01 allowed false; budget 5,5,0 then 5,5,0

steps.name: paying a promise before it is due
steps.expected: refused; nothing sent
steps.observed: done: refused

steps.name: the owner's own money out and back in; more than is free is refused
steps.expected: 5 tINR out to the owner account, 5 back, and the oversized withdrawal sends nothing
steps.observed: withdraw done: executed (99997.00 to 99992.00); deposit done: executed (99997.00); oversized done: refused

steps.name: naming a smaller venue set waits out the owner account's delay, and one passkey cancels it
steps.expected: scheduled, not run; five venues still named meanwhile; one passkey signature cancels it; still five named
steps.observed: done: scheduled; change 0x3191e95e1e… ready 2026-11-22T09:01:49.000Z; named meanwhile 5; cancel done: executed; change now cancelled

steps.name: the vault service keeps its own budget
steps.expected: a count of what was used in the rolling hour, per class
steps.observed: proposals 10/240; operations 11/240; economies 0/4

steps.name: a limit check and a quote read without signing anything
steps.expected: allowed; expected output and the provable bound
steps.observed: allowed true; expected 0.118987 tUSD, bound 0.118988, 8.404 ppm apart; source QEDExecution.quoteBound and pool reserves on the local Anvil chain

steps.name: a conversion inside the limits
steps.expected: executed in eight steps; the reserve gains what the receipt says
steps.observed: done: executed; 8 steps (interpret, mandate, owner, cosigner, plan, submit, receipt, reconcile); reserve +0.118987 tUSD; last trade 0.118987

steps.name: sending the same approved conversion again
steps.expected: the same job, and no second conversion
steps.observed: 200; duplicate true; job the same; reserve still +0.118987

steps.name: a conversion above the mandate's limit for one payment
steps.expected: refused with the rule named; no transaction
steps.observed: done: refused; proposal allowed false; failing rule: Per-conversion limit in the owner's signed mandate; transaction none

steps.name: an attack that skims the output of a genuine order
steps.expected: mined as a revert on a throwaway chain of its own; this vault unchanged
steps.observed: done: reverted; reverted NotBestExecution; Skim: the optimal route with 5% of one leg moved → reverted on-chain with NotBestExecution (on an ephemeral chain of its; treasury unchanged

steps.name: the engine ticks the standing policy by itself, with no request from an interface
steps.expected: within one five-minute slot a tick appears that nothing but the engine asked for; it converts a tranche, waits, or finds the target met
steps.observed: after 250 s: tick 1 done: executed; decision "convert": convert 25000 now (limited by impact); expected 2974065 at 3.0 bps execution cost; tranche 250.00 tINR; limited by impact

steps.name: a standing policy, then one tick under it without a new signature
steps.expected: policy active, signed by the passkey through the owner account; the tick converts a tranche, waits, or finds the target met
steps.observed: done: executed; 1 digest signed; policy active target 5 tUSD; tick done: no-action; decision "wait": wait: only 16036 can be converted now (need); reserve now 3.093052 tUSD free

steps.name: pause, try to convert, resume
steps.expected: paused; the conversion does not go through; resumed
steps.observed: pause done: executed; conversion while paused done: refused; resume done: executed

steps.name: a payment after conversions: they took only their real cost, so a payment within what is left goes through
steps.expected: the budget is the authority budget; conversions have taken a small part of what they converted; a 1 tINR payment executes
steps.observed: rule d7; available 3.51 of 5.51; conversions took 1.49 (10 tINR and more converted); payment done: executed

steps.name: a payment beyond what the authority budget has left is refused, naming it
steps.expected: refused before signing, with the co-signer's check C12 named; nothing leaves
steps.observed: 3.51 tINR against 2.51 available: done: refused; Refused before signing: a payment of 3.51 tINR to CloudCo is more than is available of the agent's authority budget (co-signer check C12, R7 D7). No transaction

steps.name: the owner grants the agent 20 tINR more authority with the passkey
steps.expected: executed with one passkey signature through the owner account; granted rises by exactly 20 tINR, earned is unchanged, no money moves
steps.observed: done: executed; 1 digest signed; granted 10.00 to 30.00; earned 0.00 to 0.00; treasury unchanged

steps.name: after the grant the same payment goes through
steps.expected: executed; the treasury pays exactly that amount
steps.observed: done: executed; treasury 99736.00 to 99732.49

steps.name: the vault service re-hashes its decision records
steps.expected: chain intact
steps.observed: ok true; 23 records

steps.name: another owner of this installation cannot read or use the vault
steps.expected: the second household gets its own vault and owner account; naming the first one's proposal or approval finds nothing; the first vault is unchanged
steps.observed: second vault qed-38f2b54e5b… owner 0x53505fBF… (done: executed; treasury 100000.00); first qed-cdeee465db… owner 0x773D1d99…; naming its proposal 404 unknown_proposal; using its approval 404 not_found
